pictures.name: EM1-The-Road
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. First-century Judea, late afternoon: two men walk slowly away from the distant walls of Jerusalem along a dusty stone road between olive trees and low hills. Cleopas, a man in his fifties with a grey-streaked beard and a brown-and-cream striped wool cloak, and his younger companion, a man of about thirty with dark curly hair and an ochre tunic, heads bowed, shoulders heavy with grief. Long shadows, soft gold light, blue haze over the hills. The two men in the middle. Sorrowful, quiet. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: EM2-The-Stranger
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. The same dusty road between olive trees: Cleopas (fifties, grey-streaked beard, brown-and-cream striped cloak) and his younger companion (about thirty, dark curly hair, ochre tunic) walk beside a third traveler in a plain cream hooded cloak who is seen only from behind, his hood up and his face never visible, one hand gesturing gently as he talks. The two men look toward him, sad but listening intently. Gold evening light behind them, long shadows. The three figures in the middle, the stranger’s back to the viewer. Hushed, wondering mood. pictures.name: EM3-Stay-With-Us
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Dusk at the stone doorway of a small village house in first-century Judea, a lamp glowing inside. Cleopas (fifties, grey-streaked beard, brown-and-cream striped cloak) and his younger companion (about thirty, dark curly hair, ochre tunic) stand at the door, one reaching out to touch the arm of the traveler in a plain cream hooded cloak, who is seen only from behind, turned as if about to walk on down the darkening road. Deep blue twilight sky, first star, warm gold spilling from the doorway. The outstretched hand in the middle. Pleading, tender. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: EM4-The-Bread-Broken
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Inside a simple first-century room at night, a rough wooden table with a single clay oil lamp. In the foreground, seen from behind and cropped at the shoulders so no face is shown, a figure in a plain cream cloak holds up a round flat loaf and breaks it in two with both hands. Across the table, lit by the lamp, Cleopas (fifties, grey-streaked beard, brown-and-cream striped cloak) and his younger companion (about thirty, dark curly hair, ochre tunic) stare with dawning recognition, eyes wide, one with a hand to his chest. The breaking bread in the middle of the frame. Sacred, astonished stillness. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: EM5-The-Empty-Seat
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same simple room at night: the seat at the near end of the wooden table is suddenly empty, a cream cloak-shaped fold of shadow where someone sat, the broken round loaf resting on the table beside the clay lamp. Cleopas (fifties, grey-streaked beard, brown-and-cream striped cloak) and his younger companion (about thirty, dark curly hair, ochre tunic) are rising from their stools, faces lit with joy and wonder, one already turning toward the door and the dark road. The broken bread in the middle. Burning hearts, joyful hurry. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: EM6-The-Red-Lamp
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, of a modern scene today: an empty Catholic church on a weekday afternoon, long wooden pews, soft daylight from tall windows. At the front, a small gold tabernacle on a stone altar, and beside it a red glass sanctuary lamp with a small flame burning. In the aisle, a young man in a denim jacket kneels on one knee, seen from behind, head slightly bowed. Dust in the light beams. The red lamp and tabernacle in the middle. Quiet, warm, present. No text, no letters, no logos.
